FULL VALIDATED CONTRACT: Entrywise compression naturality: universal e_nat > 0 such that for e=delta+epsilon <= e_nat, Q a delta-projection in an extended epsilon-C*-algebra A, n >= 1, E_{11} the (1,1) matrix unit of M_n: every Z in A satisfies Co_{I_n tensor Q, I_n tensor Q}(E_{11} tensor Z) = E_{11} tensor Co_Q(Z).
